title: Prevent blocked Engram test fixtures from deadlocking on assertion failure
outcome: Confirmed Low defect from Final16 Codex review session-7260, independently source-checked by supervisor. BlockedAdmissionTransport and LostEvaluateReplyCachingTransport in src/tests/engram_retained_disposition.rs wait on unbounded release_rx.recv(). Tests retain release_tx outside thread::scope and can panic on Resume/Cancel/assertions before releasing the worker. Scope then waits forever for a worker whose sender cannot drop until scope returns. Use existing bounded phase synchronization and/or unwind-safe release ownership, and inspect sibling new blocked fixtures for the same lifetime cycle. Already assigned within Final17 to Termal::Coder/session-7223.
acceptance: A deliberate pre-release assertion failure or aborted fixture cannot hang scoped-thread teardown; it exits with diagnostic failure. Existing successful synchronization scenarios still pass. Use existing phase deadlock guards, no sleeps/polling, and do not weaken production deadlines.
